scripts.typecheck: sh -c 'if command -v just >/dev/null 2>&1; then just typecheck; else cargo check --tests; fi'
scripts.test: sh -c 'if command -v just >/dev/null 2>&1; then just test; else if command -v cargo-nextest >/dev/null 2>&1; then cargo nextest run --no-fail-fast; else cargo test; fi; fi'
